notes: «فقال أصلى هؤلاء» and «قال إذا كنتم ثلاثة»: the Companion عبد الله speaks inside the story and his words are the saying, so he is the last link (rule 6).
«سمعت إبراهيم» is a transmission verb (rule 5): إبراهيم is a link. «علقمة، والأسود» are co-transmitters from إبراهيم.
The archive flag says the text names a further transmitter after the last stored name; the reading above follows the text, with عبد الله as the speaker.
